the-lord.name: The Lord
the-lord.note: God, answering Job out of the whirlwind and judging the friends.

1.t: I will not stir him up, like one that is cruel, for who can resist my countenance?

2.t: Who hath given me before that I should repay him? All things that are under heaven are mine.

3.t: I will not spare him, nor his mighty words, and framed to make supplication.

4.t: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can go into the midst of his mouth?

5.t: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.

6.t: His body is like molten shields, shut close up with scales pressing upon one another.

7.t: One is joined to another, and not so much as any air can come between them:

8.t: They stick one to another and they hold one another fast, and shall not be separated.

9.t: His sneezing is like the shining of fire, and his eyes like the eyelids of the morning.

10.t: Out of his mouth go forth lamps, like torches of lighted fire.

11.t: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, like that of a pot heated and boiling.

12.t: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame cometh forth out of his mouth.

13.t: In his neck strength shall dwell, and want goeth before his face.

14.t: The members of his flesh cleave one to another: he shall send lightnings against him, and they shall not be carried to another place.

15.t: His heart shall be as hard as a stone, and as firm as a smith's anvil.

16.t: When he shall raise him up, the angels shall fear, and being affrighted shall purify themselves.

17.t: When a sword shall lay at him, it shall not be able to hold, nor a spear, nor a breastplate.

18.t: For he shall esteem iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.

19.t: The archer shall not put him to flight, the stones of the sling are to him like stubble.

20.t: As stubble will he esteem the hammer, and he will laugh him to scorn who shaketh the spear.

21.t: The beams of the sun shall be under him, and he shall strew gold under him like mire.

22.t: He shall make the deep sea to boil like a pot, and shall make it as when ointments boil.

23.t: A path shall shine after him, he shall esteem the deep as growing old.

24.t: There is no power upon earth that can be compared with him who was made to fear no one.

25.t: He beholdeth every high thing, he is king over all the children of pride.
